capabilities: Render habit cards as year or half-year contribution grids
Log or remove a day's record by clicking a cell
Track amount habits with units and item habits with named items
Run challenges with a duration, weekly goal and streak
Import completed Apple Reminders from a Markdown log file
extras: Optional Mac sync installs a background job outside Obsidian that keeps running after the plugin is uninstalled unless removed first; the plugin makes no network requests and has no telemetry.
motivation: Built to log habits with Apple Reminders and visualize them in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see habit history as a calendar grid, log amounts or named items per day, or bring completed Apple Reminders into a note.

relations.evidence: Habit Grid was built to log habits with Apple Reminders and visualize them in your vault.

summary: Renders habit records kept in Markdown files as GitHub-style contribution grids, with streaks, goals, challenges and day and week views.
